purpose: HOTFIX E — Documentazione READ-ONLY del contratto TeamFormation V1 introdotto da backend/helpers/team_formation_contract.py. Sostituisce il contratto ambiguo Pack 125 ({hero_id, col, row}) e il contratto starter Pack 87 ({slot_index, user_hero_id}) con una forma canonica unica.

canonical_slot_shape.user_hero_id: owned user_heroes.id / owned copy id (NOT canonical/catalog)

size_cap.rationale: Pack 125 cap preserved by HOTFIX E. NO inflation to 9 despite 3x3 visual grid.

ui_visual_vs_save_note: La UI mostra una griglia 3x3 (9 celle visive). Il save backend rimane a max 6 membri. HOTFIX E NON ridisegna la UI.

legacy_read_compat.starter_pack_87: {slot_index, user_hero_id} → normalized to V1 via slot_index_to_grid()
legacy_read_compat.pack_125: {hero_id, col, row} → disambiguated via owned lookup; if hero_id matches user_heroes.id treated as owned id; if matches user_heroes.hero_id with unique owned record, used; if ambiguous → TEAM_FORMATION_LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS blocker

not_in_scope_of_hotfix_e: rewards / gacha / shop / VIP / BP / mail
